title: Le Vertige (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
When Jackie tells his friend Bruno that they might be living in a simulation, Bruno takes the idea surprisingly seriously. As he begins searching for glitches in reality, his ordinary day slowly starts to unravel.

 

1-hour Masterclass after the screening by the "Directors' Fortnight's Artistic Director Julien Rejl on 29 NOVEMBER at Broadway Cinematheque.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
當 Jackie 告訴朋友 Bruno，他們可能活在一個模擬世界裏，Bruno 竟出奇地認真看待這個想法。他開始在現實中尋找破綻，這樣他原本平凡的生活也逐漸分崩離析。

 

11月29日百老匯電影中心場次後設有一小時大師班，由「導演雙週」藝術總監Julien Rejl主講。
